management_steps.details: Triage to RESUS. Send INR. Administer 4-Factor PCC (Haemosolvex) 25-50 IU/kg IV. If PCC unavailable, FFP 10-15 ml/kg IV. Give Vitamin K 5-10mg IV slow infusion. Recheck INR in 30 mins.
INR 3-4.5: omit/lower next dose. INR 4.5-10: stop, give oral Vit K 1-2.5mg if high bleeding risk. INR > 10: stop, give oral Vit K 2.5-5mg. Resume at lower dose once therapeutic.
